to: you: only the socket that sent the request

fields.name: monsters
fields.description: Monster type to the kills of this character (`player.p.stats.monsters`).

fields.name: monsters_diff
fields.description: Monster type to a score correction (`player.p.stats.monsters_diff`). Each kill adds `score - 1` from `calculate_monster_score` (node/server.js:2662-2714), so the value can be negative and can have a fraction. The tracker count is `monsters + monsters_diff`.

fields.name: exchanges
fields.description: Drop table name to the exchanges of this character (`player.p.stats.exchanges`). For an item with levels (upgrade or compound), the name has the level as a suffix, for example `"armorbox0"`.

fields.name: maps
fields.description: Map name to the drop table of the map (`D.drops.maps`). It also has the keys `global` and `global_static`.

fields.name: tables
fields.description: Table name to drop table: each exchange table (`G.items[name].e`), and each table that an `"open"` entry of any table in this payload names. Upgradable and compoundable items have one table for each level: `<name><level>`.

fields.name: max
fields.description: The best values of all characters of the account (`player.max_stats`).

fields.name: monsters_home_server
fields.description: Monster type to the extra drops on the home server (`D.drops.monsters_home_server`). This is a drop table, not a kill count.

fields.name: drops
fields.description: Monster type to the drop table of the monster (`D.drops.monsters`), for every monster.

fields.name: global
fields.description: The global drop table (`D.drops.maps.global`): every kill rolls it. Present when the table exists. The live `drops.js` has it.

fields.name: global_static
fields.description: The second global table (`D.drops.maps.global_static`). Present when the table exists, even when it is empty.

confirm.note: `maps`, `tables`, `drops` and the global tables are `D.drops`, from design/drops.js; every row in that file has one of the forms of `DropRow`.

senders.what: The `tracker` handler. It sends nothing when the character has no `tracker` and no `supercomputer` in the inventory.
